digest.component_or_area: mypy type-checking ratchet and repo-wide type annotations
propositions: Fourteen rebar packages have untyped function definitions and explicit-Any usage that must be annotated to enable stricter mypy enforcement (36 annotations across 14 files, no new Any).

Two-tier mypy ratchet must be implemented: tier 1 promotes 13 packages to disallow_untyped_defs; tier 2 adds disallow_any_explicit for _cli and _snapshot, enforced as shrink-only via test_mypy_ratchet.py.

The reducer package cannot be promoted to tier 1 because match_predicate(value) depends on op argument type and requires either value: Any (violates no-new-Any criterion) or produces real type errors.
Three packages (llm, _commands, _engine) with 573 untyped defs and ~389 explicit Any are deferred as out-of-scope epic-sized work, filed as separate follow-ups.
Architecture documentation must record that disallow_untyped_defs is blind to Any, explain the two-tier ratchet mechanism, and provide the per-package baseline table for measurement.
